name: Instant Pot Chicken Bibimbap
desc: Rice, chicken, shiitake, carrot, corn and spinach pressure-cooked together in one pot and finished with gochujang and sesame oil.

source.title: High Protein Chicken Bibimbap
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 cup water (3/4 cup or 1/2 cup if your toppings are very watery)
ingredients.note: 3/4 cup or 1/2 cup if your toppings are very watery

ingredients.raw: 8 oz boneless skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into small pieces
ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breast or thighs

steps: Add the rinsed rice and water to the Instant Pot.
Layer the chicken, mushrooms, carrots, corn, spinach and ginger evenly on top of the rice. Do not stir.
Seal the lid and cook on high pressure for 5 min. Let the pressure release naturally for 10 min, then release any remaining pressure.
Check that the chicken reads 165°F. Stir in the gochujang and sesame oil, fluffing the rice and toppings together.
tips: In a rice cooker, use fewer toppings and cut the chicken smaller so it cooks through in time.

references.title: Easy High Protein Instant Pot Chicken Bibimbap
references.usedFor: chicken amount scaled to 1 cup rice; vegetable, ginger, gochujang and sesame oil amounts; layering toppings on the rice
